description:
CodeSignal is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for technical and non-technical skills evaluation and development. It provides pre-hire assessments delivered in a browser-based IDE, live collaborative technical interviews, AI-conducted screening interviews, behavioral and cognitive assessments, assessment proctoring and integrity services, experiential technical learning, and the integration, administration, reporting, identity, and API services that support them.

The offering is hosted on Amazon Web Services in the United States. Tenant data is logically segregated.

Customer data handled includes candidate, learner, and user PII (name, email address, IP address), assessment and learning content, submitted work, results, and, for the proctoring and integrity services, government-issued identity documents and session video. The offering does not process protected health information or cardholder data.

Several services use third-party foundation model subprocessors.

The Collibra Data Intelligence Cloud is your system of record for data. It delivers the only end-to-end, integrated Data Intelligence platform that is purpose-built to automate data workflows and deliver trusted data insights to users. Collibra connects IT and the business by removing the fragmentation and complexity of traditional data management technologies. The Collibra Data Intelligence Cloud enables Data Citizens to easily access trustworthy data, automate processes, manage compliance and, ultimately, make their data meaningful.

Commvault Cloud for Government delivers a fully automated cyber resilient SaaS data backup and recovery solution, with automated deployment, reduced overhead, automated patching and upgrades, continuous security monitoring, and requiring no Agency maintenance. Fully differentiated storage enables the move to cloud by providing the option to leverage cloud or on-premises storage within the web console for hybrid cloud workloads that require synchronization to sustain operational readiness and mission delivery.

Commvault Cloud for Government capabilities include the following workloads:

-Microsoft 365 - For Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive
-Dynamics 365 - For CE applications + Power Platform
-Salesforce - For Salesforce
-Active Directory - For Entra ID and Active Directory
-VM & Kubernetes – Azure VM, Kubernetes, Microsoft Hyper-V, VMWare, AWC EC2, VMWare Cloud
-Endpoint – For Laptops and Desktops
-File & Object – For Windows Server, Azure Blob & Files, OCI Object Storage, Amazon S3, Linux/Unix
-File & Object Archive – For compliance ready archiving
-Database – For Microsoft SQL, Oracle, SAP HANA
-Air Gap Protection (AGP) – secure and scalable cloud storage from Azure in minutes, delivering against your organization’s hybrid cloud strategy is available for Commvault Complete™ and HyperScale™ X deployments.
The web-based console, called Command Center, provides a holistic customer data platform with both default and customizable configurations, -automated procedures for critical data protection and recovery tasks. Command Center delivers fully automated alerts on pre-set data anomalies, integrated audit reports, key word search (e.g., identifying PII or potential data spillages) and the ability remediate data issues at the granular level (e.g., file, specific email) using integrated indexing and metadata tags designed to protect data at IL4 & IL 5.

Complete Discovery Source (CDS) is a pioneer in the eDiscovery industry, providing litigation technology and hosting, advisory services, and managed services to support complex discovery matters. With a team of seasoned legal experts and technicians, we provide leading-edge technology, advanced analytics, and a secure, scalable infrastructure to support the data initiatives of State and Federal agencies and departments. CDS is the first choice of the Am Law 100 and Fortune 500 and is recognized as Best in End-to-End eDiscovery by the National Law Journal and New York Law Journal. CDS supports more than 25 eDiscovery technologies including Relativity and Clearwell. CDS is headquartered in New York with regional offices in Washington DC, Chicago, and Houston. The company maintains highly secure ISO 27001 certified hosting and SSAE 16 Type 2 audited data centers in the US and EU.

ComplianceAide is an evidence-cited, human-approved SaaS compliance copilot for cybersecurity and regulatory readiness. The service connects to customer-approved evidence in governed repositories such as SharePoint; evaluates evidence clarity, recency, traceability, and sufficiency; maps evidence to applicable controls and framework requirements; identifies unsupported, partial, stale, missing, or conflicting evidence; and produces source-linked, review-ready assessments, reports, policies, control narratives, System Security Plan (SSP) support, Security Assessment Report (SAR) support, Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) entries, validation matrices, and executive readiness briefs. A named human reviewer approves, revises, rejects, or requests additional evidence before work product is accepted. ComplianceAide supports FedRAMP and NIST SP 800-53 readiness and package-preparation workflows; it does not replace an independent assessor or Authorizing Official, make authorization decisions, or currently represent a FedRAMP-authorized cloud service offering.

The Concourse platform is a cloud-based, configurable software platform that enables government agencies, educational institutions, and other public-sector organizations to digitize, manage, and automate their operational workflows. The platform is modular in design, allowing customers to adopt capabilities individually or in combination based on their specific requirements. Concourse delivers its services to federal, state, and local government agencies; K–12 and higher education institutions; public utilities; transit authorities; and similar public-sector organizations.

The capability categories that make up the platform are listed individually below.

ConnectSecure Vulnerability and Compliance Manager is a
cloud-hosted Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application
purpose-built for the Managed Service Provider (MSP)
community. It empowers small and medium-sized
businesses to protect their IT assets from security threats
through comprehensive, affordable vulnerability and
compliance management.

SecureCloud is provided by Valiantys Federal as a FedRAMP moderate Platform as a Service (PaaS) offering.  The solution offers a multi-tenant, cloud-based, environment, with the option for deployment of single-tenant environments if required.  Valiantys Federal solutions are designed to provide end-to-end managed hosting that empowers customers to retain complete control over the application environment, while dramatically reducing the time and cost associated with in-house administration. SecureCloud supports and deploys a variety of technologies based on tenant requirements.  Valiantys also offers a cadre of US-based personnel specializing in deployment, configuration, and management of Atlassian tools, as well as optimizing DevSecOps workflows.
Managed hosting services include performance monitoring and troubleshooting, Operating System management and patching, managed backups, and managed firewalls.  Valiantys Federal also manages system owner approved configuration changes supporting the tenant’s environment.
Providing a secure operating environment is at the forefront of SecureCloud and with that focus, Valiantys Federal provides a variety of services to meet tenant requirements for NIST, CMMC, and 800-171 requirements including audit capabilities, disaster recovery, and incident response support.   These services include DoD STIG hardened servers, vulnerability scanning, a dedicated SIEM server, and the option for Disaster Recovery as a Service to meet agency specific RTO/RPOs for mission critical applications.

Copado GovCloud is a cloud DevOps platform designed to make Salesforce releases faster, more efficient, and scalable across hundreds of production and sandbox instances. Copado GovCloud integrates with all major Git solutions and ensures developers, administrators, and low-code Salesforce users can all commit changes to a central Git repository or seamlessly deploy from a QA environment to production. Copado is used by small organizations and large enterprises across a wide range of industries to accelerate time to market for Salesforce applications, enhance developer efficiency, increase security visibility, improve Salesforce testing capabilities and enable digital cloud transformations. The services in scope for Copado GovCloud are:

- Deploying Salesforce metadata to production and sandbox instances, with Git integration for version control and branch management. 
- Change management including agile development processes, quality gates, and code scanning. 
- Continuous deployment and continuous integration, including visual pipeline configuration.
- Compliance rules for Salesforce metadata, including rule creation, monitoring, and enforcement of policies across user stories, Git snapshots, and deployments. * Test data seeding across sandboxes ensuring accurate quality assurance prior to production deployments.
Aggregation of travel data to support comprehensive reporting and analysis.

Coupa Spend Management for Federal is a cloud and mobile platform for managing procurement/acquisition/contract related processes. It covers the end-to-end process, including supplier identification, sourcing, contracting, procurement against contracts, invoicing, payments, and spend analytics to ensure compliance and efficiency.

Key capabilities include:

- Consumer-grade end user and supplier experience to ensure broad adoption of the platform and maximize the value of each dollar spent. Proven, secure solution that offers extensive configuration options, avoiding the need for custom code that is expensive to write and maintain  

- Full auditability for FAR/DFARS processes, including related contract documents and communications across internal agency team members and external vendors. Reduction in manual and paper-based processes using the latest in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Image Recognition.

-Support for compliance with Cost Accounting Standards (CAS) and other regulatory and/or compliance mandates.

vendor: Covergent Solutions Inc dba Exiger Government Solutions (EGS)
description: Exiger Government Solutions (EGS) developed a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) product named 1Exiger which provides access to multiple modules - Due Diligence Intelligence (DDIQ), Third Party Management (3PM), Supply Dynamics (SDX), and Analytics.

Dayforce HCM, Public Sector (Dayforce Pub Sec) is a Software as a Service (SaaS) Human Capital Management (HCM) cloud service offering deployed in a public cloud environment for use by U.S. Federal Government agencies. The service provides integrated capabilities for human resources, payroll, workforce management, benefits administration, document management, employee communications, analytics, reporting, and secure application integration through a single logical application platform.

The FedRAMP authorization boundary includes the Dayforce Pub Sec application services, management services, identity and access management services, document management services, integration services, messaging services, analytics services, and supporting cloud platform components required to deliver the service. Only those services, features, and components included within the authorization boundary have been independently assessed as part of the FedRAMP Moderate authorization.

The service supports federated identity using customer-managed identity providers and implements Digital Identity Level 2 (IAL2/AAL2) requirements, including multifactor authentication and identity federation, as applicable. The service employs role-based access control, privileged access management, centralized audit logging, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, and FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic modules to protect federal information in transit and at rest.

Dayforce Pub Sec is designed to process, store, and transmit Federal Moderate impact information, including Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), in accordance with FIPS PUB 199 Moderate security requirements. Security responsibilities are shared between Dayforce and customer agencies as defined in the Customer Responsibility Matrix, with customer organizations responsible for agency-managed identity governance, endpoint security, and organization-specific security controls.

The Deloitte Government and Public Sector Technology Center (GPS TC) provides Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) to government agencies, legal departments, and public entities utilizing machine technology and web services. Deloitte Evidence Management System (EMS) provides advanced technology and experienced staff to assist government agencies responding to requests stemming from litigation, congressional inquiries, FOIA, investigations, and other similar use cases. Our capabilities assist other offerings that need to collect, extract, or analyze unstructured data.

 

Deloitte EMS draws on years of experience providing government and public sector clients secure eDiscovery solutions and support. Deloitte’s highly skilled technical resources engage a full array of EDRM data management solutions and services that include identifying, preserving, collecting, reviewing, producing, dispositioning, and archiving. Clients who partner with Deloitte can utilize a wide variety of application software in a secure and scalable environment to address their identified mission requirements.

 

- Disclosure/FOIA (SecureReleaseTM) Advanced Analytics (i.e. active learning, culling data)

- NavigAite: A Generative AI solution that leverages Relativity, a Large Language Model (LLM) and prompt engineering to summarize, classify, and redact text across extensive document collections

- SmarText: An OCR solution that leverages LLMs to organize documents, perform data extraction and analysis, and identify redactions for documents integrated with SecureReleaseTM or other document review platforms and tools

- Information Governance

- Program Integrity

- Investigations (i.e., criminal, financial, employment)

- Data Collection including mobile data/devices, social media, websites, O365 Project and Contract Management Trial Support

- Customizable and tailored workflows

product: Replicon Cloud Platform (Enterprise Time Tracking Platform)
description: Replicon Inc. provides cloud time tracking applications including timesheet and expense management software, using SaaS, for automating employee time tracking, project time tracking, expense tracking and resource scheduling.

Devo is a cloud-native logging and security analytics platform. Devo ingests logs at cloud scale, stores all logs in their native format, and allows the customer to query the data immediately upon initial ingesting. Devo provides multiple applications on the platform including the Devo Intelligent SIEM, SOAR, Security Operations, MITRE ATT&CK Advisor, Relay, Collectors, and the Devo Exchange allowing the customer’s SOC and IT Operations teams to leverage and collaborate on the same data. Our newly added capabilities include, the Devo User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA), Devo ThreatLink, and Devo Data Orchestrator capabilities as well as the Devo Endpoint Agent, powered by Snare Solutions - a centralized security log collection and management platform. Additionally, in partnership with one of our Managed Security Service Providers (MSSP), we’re happy to offer Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Services.

DevResults is a web application with tools for data capture, analysis, reporting, visualizations, project management, and team collaboration. DevResults was designed to streamline fragmented data processes into a single proven system, allowing for the utilization of data for decision making across activities and throughout government agencies, non-profit organizations, and private sector companies. Over the past decade, DevResults has supported partners with managing data, measuring progress, and learning from the results. DevResults will allow users across an organization and around the world to better utilize data for management and decision-making.

DigiCert for U.S. Government helps federal agencies reduce certificate-related outages gain control over the digital identities, certificates, cryptographic keys, and software their systems depend on. The unified SaaS platform gives teams a consistent way to manage these risks across their users, devices, workloads, and applications.

Through  DigiCert® ONE  on AWS GovCloud (US), the platform helps agencies discover and automate certificate lifecycles, operate private certificate authorities, protect software-signing processes and supply chains, and enforce consistent administrative access controls. These integrated capabilities help agencies reduce certificate-related outages, strengthen cyber resilience, improve auditability, and manage digital trust across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.

DigiCert for U.S. Government includes three integrated solutions:

•	DigiCert® Trust Lifecycle Manager:
CA-agnostic certificate lifecycle management (CLM) solution providing centralized discovery, inventory, enrollment, and automated renewal of public and private certificates across users, devices, servers, and infrastructure, eliminating manual tracking and reducing certificate-related outages. It supports standard enrollment protocols (ACME, EST, SCEP, and CMP) and integrates natively with AWS services alongside CMDB platforms, endpoint management tools, identity providers, and third-party scanners.

•	DigiCert® Private CA:
Private certificate authority solution enabling organizations to create, manage, and operate privately trusted root and intermediate CAs for issuing certificates to internal users, devices, servers, and workloads.

•	DigiCert® Software Trust Manager:
A code signing and secure releases solution that provides centralized, policy-driven management of code signing keys and certificates, HSM-backed private key protection, CI/CD pipeline integrations, approval workflows, and comprehensive audit logging. DigiCert ONE environments supporting Software Trust Manager are covered by applicable independent security and compliance attestations, including SOC 2 Type II and WebTrust, depending on the deployment and region. DigiCert uses FIPS 140-2 and/or FIPS 140-3 compliant Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), as applicable, to protect cryptographic keys. Software Trust Manager helps organizations secure software signing and release processes, enforce signing policies, protect signing keys, and strengthen software release security.

Dispel Zero Trust Engine (DZTE) is a cloud-hosted zero trust remote access and privileged access management platform that provides secure, isolated, identity-federated connectivity to operational technology and enterprise environments. It delivers moving-target-defense networking, brokered remote sessions, and least-privilege access for federal and critical-infrastructure customers.

product: Dispel Zero Trust Engine (DZTE) For Government
description: DZTE is a Government-only cloud computing SaaS that provides secure remote access to critical systems, enabling customers to implement compensating controls for operational technology and legacy technology environments.

Infinibyte Cloud is a secure, flexible, and highly available public cloud platform-as-a-service (PaaS) that allows customers to host federal applications in a FedRAMP Moderate compliant environment. Infinibyte Cloud is a multi-tenant hosting platform that provides comprehensive managed solutions including the setup, configuration, security hardening, management, patching, monitoring, scanning, backup, and support of customer environments comprised of virtual machines, operating systems, and databases. The information security architecture leverages "defense in depth" concepts to provide multiple layers of security controls for customer systems. Infinibyte Cloud supports a number of operating systems, databases, services, and applications, including Microsoft Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, AlmaLinux, Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database, MySQL, MongoDB, Microsoft IIS, Apache HTTP Server.

The DNAnexus Platform is a public cloud analysis and data management platform for processing high-throughput molecular data; for combining molecular, clinical, and real-world data to discover relationships relevant to patient and population health, precision medicine, drug discovery and regulatory approval; and for enabling a network of government, academic, and commercial collaborators to securely form research communities. DNAnexus presents a Platform-as-a-Service including a brandable, customizable web interface, and an API for integration with upstream and downstream systems such as Laboratory Information Management, Clinical Trial Management, Electronic Data Capture, and clinical interpretation and reporting systems.

Precision.FDA.gov (https://precision.fda.gov/) the FDA's web service for collaborative advancement of regulatory standards for Next Generation Sequencing-based drugs and devices, is enabled by the DNAnexus Platform API, leveraging the Platform's secure and compliant analysis and data management services to deliver a fit-for-purpose interface to a secure community of researchers from government, academic, and commercial sectors.

DocuSign is a San Francisco- and Seattle-based company that provides electronic signature technology and Digital Transaction Management services to facilitate electronic exchanges of contracts and signed documents. DocuSign's features include authentication services, user identity management and workflow automation. Signatures processed by DocuSign are comparable to traditional signatures based on the product's compliance with the ESIGN Act as well as the European Union's Directive 1999/93/EC on electronic signatures. DocuSign Federal is a SaaS application oriented towards federal government entities. Operated and managed as a government community cloud, DocuSign Federal provides government customers with an enterprise signing service to facilitate paperless workflow management. More information about DocuSign Federal can be found at https://www.docusign.com/federal (https://www.docusign.com/solutions/industries/government/federal).

DocuSign CLM is a secure contract lifecycle management product in DocuSign's Agreement Cloud. DocuSign CLM manages contracts in addition to all other types of documents across desktop, mobile, and partner applications like Salesforce. DocuSign CLM goes beyond standard document and contract management with advanced workflows that automate manual tasks and complex processes to speed time-to-revenue. Businesses use DocuSign CLM to optimize collaboration and processes across internal departments, as well as with prospects and customers.

Dossier for Government is a cloud-based competency and training management solution for federal agencies. It replaces paper competency folders with a single system of record for defining the competencies each role requires, assessing staff against those requirements on recurring cycles, delivering the training that closes the gaps, and producing current competency status on demand at the team, facility, or department level.

The service is built for federal workforces with recurring, externally driven competency obligations — including clinical and nursing education staff, and healthcare technology management personnel responsible for maintaining and repairing medical equipment. Assessment schedules, advance notifications, and overdue flags are tracked by the system rather than depending on manual review of paper files.

**Services included**

- **Dossier Profile** — the core competency management service. Role-based competency definitions and assigned core tasks, assessments with assessor sign-off and proficiency ratings, configurable reassessment cycles, supporting attachments, automated notification of upcoming and overdue assessments, dashboards and reporting, role-based access control, and audit logging.
- **Dossier Learn** — an integrated learning management system. Course and training assignment, delivery, and completion tracking, linked to the competency requirements held in Dossier Profile.
- **Dossier Development Program** — structured career development supporting clinical ladder programs. Defined advancement levels and criteria, evidence submission against those criteria, and review and progression tracking.

**Security category.** Each included service is categorized Low under FIPS 199 for confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

**Information handled.** Dossier for Government holds employee competency, training, and development records: employee name, work email address, job title and role, facility and organizational unit, assigned core tasks, competency ratings, assessment and due dates, assessor identity, training and course completion records, development program submissions, supporting attachments such as checklists and certifications, account role assignment, and audit logs of user activity.

The service is not intended to hold protected health information, patient or beneficiary records, clinical or treatment data, controlled unclassified information, Social Security numbers, or financial or payment data. Permitted use is defined in the terms of service and in the Secure Configuration Guide.

Dossier for Government is delivered as multi-tenant SaaS.

Duo’s Federal Editions can verify the identity of users with secure and easy to use two-factor authentication methods that helps public sector entities satisfy NIST 800-63-3 and 53/63/171 authentication requirements. In addition to verifying users’ identities, Duo’s solution checks the security health of every device authenticating into the environment, at the time of access. Admins can use Duo to enforce stricter device and application access policies, such as blocking login requests based on location or anonymous networks. Duo ensures only trusted users and devices can access protected applications. This complete security solution prevents modern attackers that often target multiple areas - including credential theft and the exploitation of known software vulnerabilities affecting outdated software versions.

Dynatrace exists to make software work perfectly. Our platform combines broad and deep observability and continuous runtime application security with advanced AIOps to provide answers and intelligent automation from data. This enables agencies to modernize and automate cloud operations, deliver software faster and more securely, and ensure flawless digital experiences.

product: Dynatrace Platform for FedRAMP Class D (High)
description:
Dynatrace is the AI-powered platform for unified observability, security, and automation. It turns high-volume telemetry into precise answers, reducing operational risk and connecting technical decisions to mission impact. Agencies see how their systems behave, know why something broke and what it affects, and know what is likely to break next, so teams spend their time focused on the mission instead of on triage. One platform and one data model replace fragmented tools with a single source of truth, lowering the cost and complexity of the monitoring estate.

OneAgent automatically discovers and instruments applications, microservices, infrastructure, and their dependencies, and Smartscape maps those relationships in real time. Grail, a causational data lakehouse, holds logs, metrics, traces, events, and mission and business data in full context. Causal AI pinpoints root cause and impact automatically, and predictive AI forecasts capacity shortfalls, resource exhaustion, and degrading service trends before mission users are affected, so teams act on answers instead of alerts. Those answers can trigger remediation workflows from the same data and the same model. Application observability, infrastructure observability, log analytics, application security, digital experience, business observability, and AI/LLM all run on that platform.

Elastic Cloud is a family of software-as-a-service (SaaS) products that includes the Elasticsearch Service (ESS).  ESS is a service in which Elastic hosts and manages Elastic Stack components, including Elasticsearch and Kibana, on infrastructure from multiple public cloud providers including Amazon Web Services (AWS). ESS offerings include advanced Elastic Stack features such as security, alerting, monitoring, reporting, machine learning, and graphing capabilities. ESS deployments allow customers to launch with use-case-configured templates, including hot-warm-cold architecture, CPU-optimized workloads, I/O optimized workloads, and memory optimized workloads. ESS also includes enhanced security features such as default encryption at rest and Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and native authentication for hosted deployments.

The ElevenLabs Platform is a cloud-based AI voice and audio service that enables organizations to generate, transform, and deploy AI-produced speech and audio at scale. The FedRAMP Class A certification scope of the offering comprises three services — Text to Speech, Speech to Text, and Agents — delivered via the ElevenLabs API and the ElevenAgents platform, and applies only when the services are operated in Zero Retention Mode (ZRM), in which customer inputs and outputs are not retained and only system and audit data is persisted. All services share a common identity and access management layer, workspace-based multi-tenancy, and a unified data plane, with capabilities accessible to enterprise workspace administrators and developers integrating via API.

Elvo is a clinician-directed platform that supports evidence-based at-home data collection and exercise programs between skilled therapy visits, during telehealth visits, or other use cases as deemed appropriate by clinicians. For example, clinicians create home exercise programs; the platform can then deliver them through a customized interface and records objective session metrics. Those metrics can for example combine quantitative performance data with standardized qualitative ratings. The platform is highly evidence-based. It operationalizes documented protocols rather than introducing new treatment methods.

Emburse Enterprise is a cloud-based SaaS solution that enables organizations to manage employee expense reporting, approval, and reimbursement workflows. For federal agency use, the solution is designed to enable authorized users to submit, review, approve, and administer business expenses in accordance with applicable organizational travel and expense policies. Potential users within a federal agency may include employees, expense approvers, finance and administrative personnel, and authorized system administrators.

Enel X's Exchange application focuses on enabling our customers to get the best price on energy by using an online reverse auction. Customers in de-regulated energy markets can choose their energy provider. We enable competition by conducting auctions for these energy providers to compete for a customers' business, increasing liquidity and driving down price. We also provide additional consulting services like budgeting, market intelligence, and risk management. The Exchange provides an automated alerts notifications to customers based on price change trigger. It also alerts about contract change notifications, market updates, and market intelligence updates, regional news and insights, and customer price charts.

product: Esri Managed Cloud Services Advanced Plus
description: Esri is a leading provider of geographic information systems (GIS) with decades of experience hosting solutions for customers. Esri Managed Cloud Services provides organizations with ready-to-use instances of ArcGIS running in the cloud and includes the infrastructure (facilities, hardware, network, and security), the software (Esri and third party), application deployment, testing, ongoing data management (data updates, backup, and archive), technical support, monitoring, and supporting 24/7 Security Operations Center. The environment has been architected following FISMA, NIST, and CIS guidance to facilitate FedRAMP moderate geospatial Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) authorizations of our customer environments. EMCS enables quickly sharing geospatial content and providing access to critical information while the organization maintains complete control over the access to their services and maps. EMCS leverages the Amazon Web Services East / West Regions FedRAMP moderate cloud infrastructure.

LASER is a system automating the development of Living Systematic Reviews using natural language processing (NLP) and artificial intelligence techniques, which synthesizes available knowledge about a given health problem continuously and with minimal human involvement. As a result, LASER speeds up the process of literature reviews, decreases its costs, and improves the quality of the reviews allowing overworked human specialists to focus on the essential elements offloading much of the repetitive tasks to the AI-enabled system. LASER also provides a human-centric user interface, enabling smooth interaction with suggestions provided by the AI.

LASER supports classical systematic reviews as well as enables quick verification of the quality of the reviews by the regulators and the sponsors, makes it possible to perform a larger number of reviews for personalized medicine or the creation of high-quality rapid assessments in the face of epidemics or ecological disasters.

LASER is built with larger organizations in mind, providing a high level of security as well as enterprise-grade management of projects, teams, roles, shared dictionaries, and customizable workflow processes. LASER helps with the following steps of literature reviews: creation of the review protocol, construction and execution of a search strategy, T&A screening, screening of full texts, data extraction, quality assessment, export of data to meta-analysis tools.

Ex Libris Higher-Ed Platform, consisting of Alma, Primo, Leganto, Esploro and Rialto, is an open platform that provides common cross-product services while ensuring reliability, security, and ease of integration with 3rd-party products and tools.

Facility Grid is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for construction commissioning, quality control and turnover. Commissioning agents, general contractors and building owners use it to plan and record commissioning work on new and renovated buildings: equipment and system inventories, installation checklists, functional performance tests, issues and observations, schedules, documents, and the turnover package handed to the owner at completion.

**Federal use.** Facility Grid is used on federal construction and renovation projects delivered by prime contractors for the US Army Corps of Engineers, the Department of Veterans Affairs, the Department of Energy, the General Services Administration, the US Coast Guard and the Department of Homeland Security. On these projects the commissioning records are contract deliverables owned by the agency, and agency staff or agency-appointed commissioning agents use the platform to review and accept them.

**Scope.** This listing covers the Facility Grid commissioning platform (marketed as FG Construct): the web application, the REST API, and the server-side services behind the iOS and Android apps. It runs on Amazon Web Services in the commercial us-east-2 region. FG Validate and FG Sustain are separate products and are not part of this offering. The mobile apps are installed client software and are outside FedRAMP scope; the services they call are in scope.

**Certification path.** Facility Grid is pursuing a FedRAMP 20x Class A Certification for the existing commercial service on the strength of its SOC 2 Type II examination, and a Class C (Moderate) Certification afterwards, assessed by Insight Assurance.
Files.com is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform with one unified application and API to manage, store, and transfer files across your organization.

OpenBlue Employee, formerly FMS:Employee, offers solutions for organizations with powerful, integrated scheduling features. Built for flexible, collaborative workplaces and designed to increase efficiency and productivity for in-office and remote employees. OpenBlue Employee features desk and resource scheduling, interactive floor plans, contactless workflows, visitor management, and much more. 

Room & Resource Scheduling - Quickly find and reserve rooms, equipment and services for your remote and in-office employees.

Hoteling & Desk Sharing - Give employees easy access to calendars and reserve spaces with the convenience of mobile scheduling.

Service Management - Streamline complex orders and keep service providers one step ahead of your fast-paced organization with pricing and inventory controls and a dynamic management console.

Interactive Floor plans - Desk-sharing initiatives are the future of modern workplaces as cloud and mobile technologies offer an ‘anytime, anywhere’ work style.

Outlook Integration - Make the most of your Outlook calendar by integrating with our room booking and resource scheduling software.

Event & Visitor Management - Ensure events and visitors are managed properly from start to finish. Set up new events and capture critical information with a few simple clicks.

IoT Sensor Integration - Measure actual workspace utilization and identify patterns and trends to build a smarter workspace.

Workplace Services & Booking Hardware - Simplify operations and encourage collaboration with streamlined service management and interactive booking hardware.

Reporting & Analytics - Dive into the data and analyze trends by location, person, or department to understand what spaces are underutilized and under-performing.

OpenBlue Workplace is an Integrated Workplace Management Solution (IWMS) designed for space management and optimization, asset management, move management, facility maintenance, strategic real estate planning, and facility project management. 

The core system consists of Space + Asset Management with Strategic Planning. Additionally, optional modules may be licensed for the core system for move management, facility maintenance, real estate and lease management and project management as part of the Integrated Workplace Management System. 

This web-based solution enables organizations to manage, analyze and report on facilities and real estate operation and maintenance (O&M) information. With objective facility data and digital automation, customers gain insight into how their real estate portfolio is performing, identify opportunities to reduce costs, create efficiencies across workplace management processes and deliver exceptional workplace experiences to their employees. The system is a web-based application requiring only a browser for the client. 

CAD and BIM technicians may leverage an entirely optional AutoCAD™ or Revit™ client side plug-in that communicates to  OpenBlue Workplace via web services. This bi-directional system’s integration simplifies the floorplan management process for technicians as it keeps both systems in sync when changes are made. The AutoCAD and Revit plug-ins add the ability to edit digital floorplan files within OpenBlue Workplace but are not a required component for the system. There is also an optional HR Data Feed available to import customer users into the system. OpenBlue Workplace is hosted as a single tenant server in the AWS GovCloud FedRAMP environment. 

OpenBlue Workplace uses a self-described data model—the OpenBlue Workplace Data Dictionary—that lets system administrators configure the system to add, modify or remove fields, tables, data views, data forms, notification rules, reports, and business logic. The Data Dictionary is unique to the individual client database, allowing each organization to design and configure the system according to their unique business requirements.

The OpenBlue Workplace Management Suite and associated modules allow facility and real estate professionals to use a common database and system to address a wide range of business requirements and to share facility information enterprise wide.

Support Government construction cost estimating and program support for a variety of programs, including but not limited to JOC, SABER, SATOC, MATOC, IDIQ, spanning repair, renovation, maintenance, new construction, and sustainment of facilities and other built structures and associate planning, procurement, and project delivery activities and teams.

Fulcrum is a cloud manufacturing operations system for small and mid-sized discrete manufacturers, including CNC machine shops, sheet metal fabricators, and aerospace and defense suppliers. It combines ERP, MRP and manufacturing execution in one web application, from quoting and planning through scheduling, shop-floor tracking, quality, shipping and invoicing.

Archie, the AI built into Fulcrum, answers questions about a customer's live shop data, takes actions on it, and builds custom pages and tools. Customers can also connect their own AI assistants to the same data tools through the Fulcrum MCP server, within each user's permissions. Archie's AI models are hosted in Microsoft Azure Government with the rest of the offering, so prompts to Archie and the shop data it reads stay in Azure Government; a customer's own assistant runs wherever the customer chooses.

Customers reach the service through a web browser, a REST API and MCP.

GDCI provides proven, efficiently priced Federalized SaaS Human Resource
Applications to support the critical human capital functions across the employee
lifecycle.

Time, Attendance & Leave:
Paycheck 8 reduces the challenging and time consuming effort of tracking and reporting time, attendance, and leave (including VLTP and FLMA). Utilizing agency/department
business rules, Paycheck8 pre-edits to eliminate and reduce time-entry errors, corrected T&A’s and Leave balances. 

Labor and Employee Relations:
Labor-Employee Relations Information System (LERIS) is a state-of-the-art case management and reporting system designed to meet the needs of the labor/employee relations specialist, EEO case manager and other HR specialists, along with agency leadership.

Performance Management:
ePM is a proven web-based HR system developed to support the effective management, process development, and performance tracking of the appraisal process from start to finish, while maintaining compliance with performance and awards laws.

Onboarding:
eForms is innovative technology designed to improve productivity and eliminate redundant manual data entry for new employee enrollment. It is inclusive of the new hire process and management of enrollment forms and procedures.

HR Self Service:
Connect HR is an easy to manage HR dashboard designed to leverage the benefits of single sign on, role management, collaboration, communication, business intelligence and document management.

Personnel Actions & Awards Tracking:
eTracker is a tool developed to easily and efficiently manage, process and track Request for Personnel Action (SF 52), Notification of Personnel Action (SF 50) and Awards Processing.

Uniform Management:
The Uniform Allowance Management System (UNAW) conveniently provides complete processing, tracking and approval of uniform allowance requests online.

Organizational Chart Automation:
FedChart is a workforce planning tool that automates the creation, maintenance, and updating of organizational charts, adhering to agency-specific business rules and
requirements. Utilizing federal HR data, FedChart visualizes an agency’s organizational structure, positions, and workforce costs.

HR Data Reporting Automation:
FedLens is a research-based, three module tool designed to enhance data-driven workforce management and planning through automated reports, trend analysis, and predictive analytics. It comprises three modules (Diagnostics, Snapshots, and Predictions) which provide insight based on data benchmarked against standards from the Office of Personnel Management (OPM).

FEVS Data Reporting Automation:
FedViews is an automated tool for Federal Employee Viewpoint Survey (FEVS) reporting, trend analysis, and workforce planning. It assists federal agencies in generating FEVS reports in compliance with OPM requirements and enables federal HR leaders to compare viewpoint data over time, identify trends, and benchmark scores across departments and within agencies. Action planning modules allow agencies to develop targeted action planning to improve engagement over time.

The GTS-VP offers Customer Agencies a powerful, flexible and convenient solution to provide Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), Real Time Telehealth visits, and Store and Forward Technology (labs, images, and clinical data) services. The GTS-VP connects healthcare providers, patients, and patient families to communicate healthcare information from remote patient monitoring tools and through video-teleconferencing. The GTS-VP integrates with RPM medical devices from most any manufacturer and can be readily configured to work across multiple disease types and chronic conditions.
